Google Drive setup

Backup & restore
Export your data when moving devices or keeping an offline copy. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
Moving to a new device? Download a backup here, transfer the file securely, then use Restore from backup on the new device.

September 2026

What's new in Selvam

Recent improvements focused on clearer household finance tracking, safer desktop storage and better statements.

v2026.09.30
💳
Credit-card spending linked to expenses

Credit-card purchases can now be connected with your tracked card while keeping spending and stated debt balance separate.

▤
Professional statements

Create monthly or custom-period statements with cash-flow summaries, original currencies and detailed transaction records.

🏦
Savings & investment transfers

Money moved to savings, emergency funds, goals and investments is tracked separately from normal spending.

🛡️
Safer Windows storage

Atomic saves, recovery backups and tighter Electron restrictions improve resilience of the desktop app.

📜
Improved activity history

Activity now has search, action filters, date ranges, summary statistics and CSV export.

Protect this backup?

Your backup file will download unencrypted by default — readable by anyone who opens it. You can optionally lock it with a PIN, same as App Lock, so the file itself is unreadable without it.
If you protect it and forget this PIN later, the backup file cannot be opened — by you or anyone else.

Record loan payment

Link the EMI to the income or funds that actually paid it.

1. What did the lender receive?
2. Which income / funds paid it?
This links the payment to your source of money. Selvam will not reduce the income entry itself — the new expense will reduce your monthly balance.
3. Update the loan?
What Selvam will do Create an expense linked to this loan and funding source.
↗

Move money

Track savings, emergency-fund contributions and investments without treating the principal as an expense.

1. What are you doing with the money?
2. Where is the money coming from?
Choose the income entry if this came from salary or another recorded income. Selvam links it; it does not reduce the income entry itself.
3. Where is it going?
How Selvam will calculate it The transfer will reduce money available to spend, but the principal will not be counted as spending.
